Class Role

java.lang.Object
Role
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Librarian, User
public abstract class Role extends Object
Abstract class representing a role in the Library Management System.

This serves as a base class for different types of accounts, such as Admin and User. Each role has an ID, username, password, email, and login status.

Provides basic getters and setters, including validation for email format and management of login status.
